title: openlake-project/openlake
claim: OpenLake — a Rust/io_uring distributed object store built for GPU workloads: training data, checkpoints and KV-cache served at million-plus IOPS with sub-ms latency, RDMA support, and a hosted cloud already live.
why_good: GPU clusters increasingly idle while storage feeds them — checkpoint restore and KV-cache offload are the bottleneck you can't fix by buying more GPUs. A store designed for that access pattern (not a generic S3 clone) attacks real burn, and 111 open issues show users genuinely pushing on it.
value: sell throughput to GPU-rich teams — managed cloud (cloud.theopenlake.com) plus on-prem enterprise licenses; storage priced against wasted GPU-hours is one of the easiest ROI stories in AI infra.
risk: Storage is the hardest enterprise sale — durability trust against VAST, Weka, MinIO and every cloud's own AI tier. 17 contributors and no visible funding is thin backing for a system customers bet training runs on.

zh.claim: openlake-project/openlake —— 面向高效 LLM 推理与 GPU 训练的高性能存储引擎。
zh.why_good: 专为 LLM 推理和 GPU 训练打造的高性能存储引擎(2290★、422 fork)——模型 I/O 卡住 GPU,是真实的基础设施痛点。
zh.value: 卖给 AI 基础设施团队和云厂做托管/企业存储层;按量 + 支持,GPU 团队本就有这笔预算。
zh.risk: 重基础设施,要和云原生存储、vLLM 生态竞争;规模化采用需要跑分和信任。
